compliance.finding: DNS and HTTPS verification resolved only a globally routable destination during this observation; admission must repeat per-hop SSRF validation.
Both verified HTTPS collection entry points returned 200 on the same host without a redirect; result links using HTTP are not authorization and must be upgraded to same-host HTTPS before validation.
The wildcard group has an empty Disallow and separately disallows /CAAC/local/ and /image/; the selected collection and detail boundaries are outside those paths.

No separate automated-use terms were linked from the verified official collection or site map. This finding grants no collection permission; SourceAdmission must recheck and fail closed if policy changes or remains insufficient.

The official footer asserts China Civil Aviation Administration website copyright. The research boundary permits metadata, necessary short evidence excerpts, and original links only; no full-text or attachment redistribution.
The institution-filtered list and sampled airport-runway engineering detail were publicly readable without login, CAPTCHA, paywall, or access-control bypass.
The official fl=60 collection returned HTTP 200 and a paginated set of Airport Department records at verification time.

research_notes: fl=60 is the official institution classification for 机场司 and is narrower than the CAAC root or general site search.
Document-level DirectRelevance remains mandatory because the stream also contains administrative and operating material.
This record updates research disposition only and does not create SourceAdmission, Owner intent, PAUSE, runtime, or coverage credit.
